notes: No open kb/Work note owns the fix. §1985:VI.6.17.2 prints INITIALIZE, one or more identifier-1, and an optional REPLACING phrase of one or more items, each item ONE of the five category words (ALPHABETIC, ALPHANUMERIC, NUMERIC, ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED, NUMERIC-EDITED) inside plain braces, then DATA (optional) BY (required) and identifier-2 or literal-1; the printed page (folio VI-92, rendered) shows braces there and no choice indicators. Implemented at 85: initializeStatement, initializeOperandList, initializeReplacingPhrase and initializeReplacingItem parse it (DATA optional, BY required: the witness's REPLACING NUMERIC DATA 5 is COBOL5506), and the later phrases reach 1985 as refusals: VersionConformancePass.VisitInitializeStatement refuses WITH FILLER, TO VALUE, TO DEFAULT and THEN before REPLACING below COBOL-2002 (COBOL0830 to COBOL0833), and VisitInitializeCategoryName refuses the eight later category words (COBOL0900). Probed at --std 85: several identifiers with and without a comma, all five categories in one phrase with identifier and literal senders, and DATA omitted compile and run; a second REPLACING phrase, a missing category, a missing operand, two operands after BY and a category named in two items (COBOL0834) are refused. PARTIAL for one arm: initializeCategory is initializeCategoryName+, the choice-indicator set of the 2002 and later formats, and InitializeBinder.CategorySetOf binds the set with no edition arm, so one REPLACING item naming two categories (REPLACING NUMERIC ALPHANUMERIC DATA BY ZERO) compiles and runs at 85. The 1985 braces take one option (§1985:IV.2.1.4: "one of the options contained within the braces must be either explicitly specified or implicitly selected"; the same clause defines choice indicators separately, and this format has none). kb/Work PB415 (landed) made the multi-category form compile at 85 on the 2023 figure, and conformance-suite/cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb415_initialize_multi_category_85 pins that acceptance; a fix must reverse that golden.

next.reason: 1985: "REPLACING {ALPHABETIC|ALPHANUMERIC|NUMERIC|ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED|NUMERIC-EDITED} DATA BY"; 2023: "[ WITH FILLER ] [ {ALL|category-name} TO VALUE ] [ THEN REPLACING … ] [ THEN TO DEFAULT ]; category-name adds BOOLEAN, NATIONAL, DATA-POINTER…". 2023 format still accepts every 1985 form but adds the WITH FILLER, TO VALUE and TO DEFAULT phrases and eight more REPLACING categories, so more programs are accepted.
